answer: A strong defence is a per-identity refundable stake tied to a verifiable work history: before an agent can earn, it must lock a deposit and build a record of completed, attested jobs over time, like a crystal that only grows slowly from dawn through many days. A single fake identity is cheap, but a gale of thousands of fakes must each pay the deposit and wait out the same slow history, so the attacker pays linearly while honest agents pay once.
